notes.title: The smallest patch ever
notes.content: Changed the position of 'i' and 'e' in 'recieved' in one cutscene. Now it's 'received' as it should be. That's right, I took up precious download time to fix a [b]spelling error[/b]! Now nobody can claim I don't care!

notes.title: Chill Update
notes.content:
- Added a very easy difficulty setting named Chill. Double damage and almost no spawned ichor fields. While I don't think a lot of people will play at this difficulty, I still want people to have the option.
- You can now change your difficulty at practically any time from the options menu. A reload from your last save or checkpoint is required in that case, however.
- Added a very small accessibility feature that allows you to darken the subtitle textbox background to make the text stand out a little more.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
I got some feedback, and there may or may not have been some potential issues with monitors, mouse and keyboard, and potentially even the PS5 controller not registering. I updated some software, changed some settings, hacked some code together, and [i]hopefully [/i]those issues will be mitigated.

Also, if you're using a PS4 controller, now the light should change.

Keep in mind that the developer updating to a new version of Unity may or may not introduce some slight issues. If you encounter any problems, don't be shy and post that as a topic in the general discussions! Making a game can be such a chaotic process at times.

Heck, even if the game runs perfectly and you're having fun, you can STILL post feedback there! The absolute worst I can do is ignore it. ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Hotfix 1 Post-release
notes.content: Fixed one typo. Today I learned there was a difference between 'advice' and 'advise' and it was bothering me so much it took priority.
